email.subject1: a signal play for Thrive Global
email.body1:
Sarah, saw Thrive Global partnered with Microsoft to roll wellbeing into Teams for its global workforce.

A flagship win like that usually pulls in more enterprise accounts than the team can cover, and that is where good deals go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Thrive Global off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sarah, quick follow-up for Thrive Global.

After a marquee partnership, inbound and enterprise interest tend to outrun headcount, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target. The gap usually shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Thrive Global needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sarah, last bit of proof for Thrive Global.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Thrive Global's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise SaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sarah, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding a marquee partnership is its own kind of busy and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to Thrive Global either way.
